\e[1mTranscript recovery\e[0m

Session synthetic-session cannot
prove that the current transcript
extends its retained history.

\e[1mConsequences\e[0m

Archived history, feedback and
handoffs stay under the earlier ID.
Each generation expires
independently under normal
retention.
The new generation is queued locally
for normal sync. Recovery
permanently requires a
generation-aware writer; older
binaries will refuse this data
directory.

To start this generation, run agent-archive recover synthetic-session --confirm.
